notes: Read from the accepted manuscript, not the version of record; the values checked (Table I range, the 7-houses sentence) should be the same in print but page numbers differ. The study's own result, not used by the paper: open-water instantaneous daily mortality of YOY largemouth bass was 0.04–0.19 d⁻¹ across the 13 lakes and was unrelated to coarse woody habitat density, branchiness or macrophyte cover (abstract; Table I; p. 14). That is relevant to §3.6 (YOY mortality) and to any model assumption that wood lowers YOY mortality.
